title: FORMAT with "Short Time" is the 24-hour time without seconds
query: EVALUATE VAR DT = DATE ( 2021, 1, 2 ) + TIME ( 15, 30, 0 ) RETURN ROW ( "r", FORMAT ( DT, "Short Time" ) )

source.quote: FORMAT accepts a set of predefined format strings for Date/Time
source.supports: the example table lists each predefined format applied to January 2, 2021 at 15:30:00

source.quote: Displays a time in 24 hour format. For example, 11:07.
